title: Watch
summary: A watch combines a tiny motor, gears, and hands to show you the time all day long!

parts.label: Dial
parts.why: It's the face of the watch where the numbers and hands appear. It exists so you can read the time clearly.

parts.label: Hands
parts.why: They point to the numbers on the dial. They exist so that a single glance tells you what time it is.

parts.label: Crown
parts.why: It's the small button on the side that you turn. It exists so you can set the time or wind the watch.

parts.label: Battery
parts.why: It stores electrical energy. It exists to power the tiny motor that moves the hands.

parts.label: Gears
parts.why: They're small toothed wheels that fit into each other. They exist to turn the motor's energy into the exact movement of the hands.

title: Bicycle
summary: A bicycle turns the strength of your legs into movement, using wheels, a chain, and brakes working as a team!

parts.label: Wheels
parts.why: They're round so they roll easily. They exist to carry the bike forward and keep it balanced.

parts.label: Pedals
parts.why: They're where you put your feet to push. They exist to turn the strength of your legs into movement.

parts.label: Chain
parts.why: It connects the pedals to the back wheel. It exists to carry the force from the pedals to the wheel, making it spin.

parts.label: Brakes
parts.why: They grip the wheel when you pull the lever. They exist so you can stop the bike safely.

parts.label: Seat
parts.why: It's where you sit. It exists to give you comfortable support while you pedal.

title: Flashlight
summary: A flashlight stores electrical energy and turns it into light, exactly when you need it!

parts.label: LED bulb
parts.why: It's the part that shines. It exists to turn electrical energy into light.

parts.label: Batteries
parts.why: They store electrical energy inside them. They exist to power the whole flashlight.

parts.label: Switch
parts.why: It's the button you press. It exists to open or close the electrical circuit, turning the light on or off.

parts.label: Reflector
parts.why: It's the shiny, cup-shaped piece around the bulb. It exists to gather all the light into one strong beam.

parts.label: Case
parts.why: It's the outer body of the flashlight. It exists to protect all the parts inside and be easy to hold.

title: Smartphone
summary: A smartphone combines a screen, camera, speaker, and a tiny electronic brain to do many things at once!

parts.label: Touchscreen
parts.why: It shows images and senses your finger. It exists so you can see and tap to give the phone commands.

parts.label: Battery
parts.why: It stores electrical energy inside. It exists so the phone works even far from a plug.

parts.label: Camera
parts.why: It captures the light coming through the tiny lens. It exists so you can take photos and videos.

parts.label: Speaker
parts.why: It makes the air vibrate. It exists to turn electrical signals into sound you can hear.

parts.label: Processor
parts.why: It's a tiny chip that does millions of calculations every second. It exists to be the brain that runs everything in the phone.

title: Camera
summary: A camera captures light in an instant and saves it as an image forever!

parts.label: Lens
parts.why: It's the curved piece of glass at the front. It exists to bend light and focus the image sharply.

parts.label: Sensor
parts.why: It sits behind the lens. It exists to turn the light it receives into digital information, creating the photo.

parts.label: Shutter
parts.why: It's a small curtain that opens and closes very fast. It exists to control how long light enters the camera.

parts.label: Shutter button
parts.why: It's the button you press with your finger. It exists to tell the camera the exact moment to take the photo.

parts.label: Memory card
parts.why: It's a small card inside the camera. It exists to store all the photos and videos you take.

title: Piano
summary: A piano turns the touch of your fingers into hammers striking strings, creating music!

parts.label: Keys
parts.why: They're what you press with your fingers. They exist so you can give the command to play a note.

parts.label: Hammers
parts.why: Each key moves a small hammer. They exist to strike the right strings and make the sound.

parts.label: Strings
parts.why: They're tight wires inside the piano. They exist to vibrate when the hammer hits them, creating the sound of the note.

parts.label: Soundboard
parts.why: It's a large wooden board beneath the strings. It exists to make the strings' sound much louder and richer.

parts.label: Pedals
parts.why: You press them with your feet. They exist to let the sound last longer or become softer.

title: Airplane
summary: An airplane uses wings, engines, and a rudder working together to fly high up in the sky!

parts.label: Wings
parts.why: They have a special curved shape on top. They exist to create lift and keep the plane in the air.

parts.label: Engines
parts.why: They hang below the wings. They exist to push the plane forward with a lot of force.

parts.label: Tail and rudder
parts.why: It's at the back of the plane. It exists to keep the plane stable and help it turn sideways.

parts.label: Landing gear
parts.why: They're the wheels that come out from under the plane. They exist so the plane can take off and land safely.

parts.label: Cockpit
parts.why: It's at the front of the plane, full of buttons and screens. It exists for the pilots to control and check everything during the flight.
